card.name: The word if after Do not use
card.fires_on: The word "if" right after a "Do not use" or "Do not take" phrase in warnings, where a condition is about to be listed. Also "candidate" in a question about who is a good candidate.

modes.label: The warning phrase "do not use if"
modes.description: The word "if" opening the condition after a do-not-use or do-not-take warning.
modes.example: WARNING Do not use<< if>> imprinted seal under bottle cap is missing

modes.label: The question of who is a good candidate
modes.description: The word "candidate" in a heading asking who is suited for a procedure.
modes.example: the tumor may range from a scar to total disruption of a facial structure such as the nose, lips, eyes, or ears. Who is a good<< candidate>> for Reconstructive Skin Cancer Surgery?

card.writes: It seems to prepare words about who the statement applies to, such as anyone or everyone.
